ov: Four species: the spotted, brown and striped hyenas, which can crush and eat bones, and the insect-eating aardwolf. Spotted hyenas are powerful hunters as well as scavengers, living in large, female-led clans. Hyenas are vital parts of most African ecosystems.

why.dg: Spotted hyenas are usually shy around people, but they do occasionally prey on humans, and attacks are likely under-reported.
why.ac: Mainly nocturnal, sometimes out in the early morning.

df: Meat, whether hunted or scavenged. Bone-crushing hyenas can eat the bones too.
fx: Spotted hyena society is matriarchal: females are larger than males and dominate them.
Hyenas first appeared in Eurasia about 22 million years ago, as small, civet-like animals.
